Reference / os/platform

os/platform#

Platform answers the portable runtime identity when asked.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let platform = Platform();
match platform.operating_system() {
    case OperatingSystem.windows { configure_windows(); }
    case OperatingSystem.macos { configure_macos(); }
    case OperatingSystem.linux { configure_linux(); }
    else { configure_portable(); }
}

Description#

Platform answers the portable runtime identity when asked. Consumers branch only on the deliberately small OperatingSystem enum; less common systems remain usable through OperatingSystem.other and architecture().

Byte order describes the running machine. Serialized formats must still choose their byte order explicitly instead of inheriting this value:

output.writeln(platform.architecture());
if platform.byte_order() == ByteOrder.little {
    output.writeln("little-endian host");
}
